collection.title: Mercedes-Benz E Class Coupe 1993 to 1999 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Mercedes-Benz E Class Coupe 1993 to 1996 (C124) model requires a 24" wiper blade and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment.
